_comment: Live trigger eval-set for plan-flow. Positives = plan/HOW-only requests; negatives = spec-only, implementation, test, or ambiguous design requests owned by other skills.

queries.query: Onayli spec'e gore implementation plan ve task breakdown hazirla, kod yazma.
